selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-worker is a managed, enabled, long-running service
selected_evidence.summary: Systemd reports the unit enabled and active; its heartbeat demonstrates ongoing work.
Tests within the service mount namespace allowed writes in /var/lib/inventory while denying writes to /var/lib, /etc, and /tmp, both before and after reboot.
Systemd reports NoNewPrivileges=yes, the live process reports NoNewPrivs: 1, and the capability bounding set is empty.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 4b43f122-6c8b-4c87-b01a-12705c4a9f4f, acknowledged the native reboot, then observed changed boot ID 1a102212-3901-4d89-ad6b-174de6966e6e with the system running and the enabled worker, changing heartbeat, NoNewPrivileges, and confinement fully recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent group inventory-worker >/dev/null; then groupadd --system inventory-worker; fi
if ! id inventory-worker >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --system --gid inventory-worker --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventory-worker; fi
install -d -o inventory-worker -g inventory-worker -m 0700 /var/lib/inventory
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'while :; do date -u +%%FT%%TZ > /var/lib/inventory/heartbeat; sleep 5; done'
Restart=always
RestartSec=2s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
PrivateIPC=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
SystemCallArchitectures=native
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
InaccessiblePaths=/tmp /var/tmp /run/user

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service

set -eu
sleep 6
systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager
printf '\nunit-security-properties:\n'
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p User -p Group -p MainPID -p NoNewPrivileges -p ProtectSystem -p ProtectHome -p ReadWritePaths -p InaccessiblePaths -p CapabilityBoundingSet
pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service)
printf '\nprocess-status:\n'
sed -n '/^Name:/p;/^Uid:/p;/^Gid:/p;/^NoNewPrivs:/p' "/proc/$pid/status"
printf '\nworker-data:\n'
stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a size=%s' /var/lib/inventory /var/lib/inventory/heartbeat
cat /var/lib/inventory/heartbeat

commands.command:
set -eu
pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service)
uid=$(id -u inventory-worker)
gid=$(id -g inventory-worker)
printf 'mount-namespace-write-test pid=%s uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$pid" "$uid" "$gid"
nsenter -t "$pid" -m -- setpriv --reuid="$uid" --regid="$gid" --clear-groups --no-new-privs /bin/sh -c '
for p in /var/lib/inventory/confinement-probe /var/lib/confinement-probe /etc/confinement-probe /tmp/confinement-probe; do
  if touch "$p" 2>/dev/null; then printf "ALLOWED %s\n" "$p"; else printf "DENIED %s\n" "$p"; fi
done
rm -f /var/lib/inventory/confinement-probe
'
test ! -e /var/lib/confinement-probe
test ! -e /etc/confinement-probe
test ! -e /tmp/confinement-probe
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
